# Luma Connector for Muse

💳 Paid API required: this connector needs a paid third-party API — the listing is free, but usage is billed. See Prerequisites for costs.

A Muse agent skill that generates short-form video with Luma's Dream Machine API: text-to-video and image-to-video, plus generation cancel and image upload for reference frames. A strong default for short clips in the catalog. Honest note: app subscription credits and API credits are separate products with separate billing and separate balances — do not mix them; generations here spend API credits (~$0.08/sec for Ray2-class video, recheck the live pricing page). The skill confirms before every generation, stating the model and expected duration/cost. Output MP4 URLs are temporary — download promptly. Draft: written from Luma's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
